title: Rotate through tree cover: on the zone trip, while an enemy beyond 45 m sees us, step to a nearby tree-hidden spot that does not lose ground to the entry point (TREE_ROTATE_ON)
behaviors: in 'to next circle' (t >= 10), while an enemy beyond 45 m has line of sight and trees+buildings do not already hide us from all such enemies: head for the nearest spot 1-3 s away that trees+buildings hide from all of them and that is at least 0.5 s of walking closer to the entry point, else one 1-2 s away that is no farther from it, only if the trip still fits (distance via the spot / (zoneWalk x walk speed) + zoneBuffer < time left); otherwise the champion's route
next_action: Grok: assign or keep parked. Step A passed on P48 trees on; a build still needs the full BUILD_CHECKLIST 4-base screen.
single_decision: The next step of the zone trip. Today 'to next circle' follows the nav path to the entry point (brain.ts:756-760, entry brain.ts:542-545) whoever watches. This allows a short detour into tree shadow when it costs no ground.
trigger: TREE_ROTATE_ON AND obs.t >= 10 AND mode === 'to next circle' AND enemies beyond 45 m with seenAt(..., false) non-empty AND not already tree/building-hidden from all AND a qualifying spot exists AND the trip still fits AND NOT (near-and-reachable drop OR dropMove OR dropHold).
hook: brain.ts act(), zone-travel branch brain.ts:756-760: if TREE_ROTATE_ON and a qualifying tree spot exists, `move = heading(spot)` for that decision; boost rule unchanged. Shared tree helper with P45/P46 (one flag here).
gates: Not before t = 10 s. Zone travel ranks above the drop run (brain.ts:751-760), so a drop run cannot be active that tick; the near-and-reachable gate is applied anyway. The fit test keeps zone safety; a 3 s no-progress give-up.
drop_gate: Drop gate (Doug 8:58 PM ET rule, near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M): the rule is off on any tick where a drop passes the champion's own drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, flat distance <= DROP_RUN_M, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time; brain.ts:731-736) or dropMove/dropHold is on, and it yields to a drop run/hold on the same tick. A plain 'no drop listed' gate is not used (an untaken drop sits in obs.drops most of the game; it killed P26b, P33, P29b). Plain gate: 0/192 on both sets (zone trips always have a drop listed).
tree_model: Tree cover test (observable: the kit map files hello.map.dir/v2/world.json, 1560 trees, rules.canopyDensity 0.35, canopyBlockT 0.25; protocol.md:369-372, :452): a spot p is hidden from enemy e when both e's eye-to-our-center and eye-to-our-top lines are blocked by a building (map.ts clearLine) or by a tree: a trunk always, canopy only when e is beyond near_range 45 m and the transmittance exp(-0.35 x metres inside crowns) is below 0.25. Shots ignore trees (protocol.md:317), so hiding behind a tree does not stop our own fire.

evidence.protocol: protocol.md:369-372: canopy is soft, trunks block sight, canopy does not block inside near_range 45 m; :317 trees do not stop shots; :452 world.json trees. Our bot never reads trees: map.ts:119 clearLine covers buildings/terrain only, and seenAt (brain.ts:405) and hideSpot (brain.ts:425) use it.
evidence.sim_trees_on: Champion trees-on baselines (/workspace/tester/runs): P29 b6f2f8b mean (16-place) 3.562 -> 3.708 (2000+3000) and 3.870 -> 4.083 (4000+5000) when trees are switched on; deaths before 40 s 56 -> 48 and 54 -> 38. P34 0e6fadd trees on: 3.750 and 4.099, deaths before 40 s 48 and 38. Trees on is now the official screen (coord/WORKFLOW.md 475eb09).
evidence.sim_rotation: Trees on, P34 champion: an enemy beyond 45 m sees us on the zone trip (and trees do not already hide us) in 35/192 and 46/192 games; a tree spot that gains ground exists in only 6 and 6 games; allowing no-loss steps raises it to 13 and 21 (reach gate).
evidence.sim_zone_deaths: P-D-007 Step A (PR #124): deaths with zone travel in the last 5 s 28/192 and 37/192 (trees off, 6182d29); zone travel yields almost no kills.
evidence.drop_run_variant_dropped: Routing drop runs through tree cover: by the drop gate it is a drop run, so 0 triggers; ungated a progress-making tree spot exists in only 8 and 7 games. Not recorded (drop-run family, under the bar).

trigger_counts_trees_on.gates: Gates as counted: none; plain = obs.drops empty; narrow = no drop (holder null or us) within DROP_RUN_M and no dropMove/dropHold; reach = 'near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M' (Doug 8:58 PM ET follow-up): no drop that passes the champion's own drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, within DROP_RUN_M, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time; brain.ts:731-736 on main 8c130ad) and no dropMove/dropHold that tick. Spec gate = reach.
trigger_counts_trees_on.caveat: The trip-still-fits test was not applied when counting, so these are upper bounds; the 2000+3000 count is close to the 10/192 bar.

estimated_activation: 13/192 and 21/192 games (reach gate, upper bound before the fit test).
closest_prior_test: P-D-007 Step B ZONE_EARLY_S (when to leave) failed in sim; P-D-010 travel delay measurement (no build); P40 roof jet route (route family) queued. No zone-route or tree test.
what_would_disprove: Fires < 10/192 once the fit test is applied; more zone damage, later arrivals or more zone-travel deaths; drop-ring set totals below the champion.
risks: Zone safety: any detour on a just-in-time trip can cost zone damage (the fit test must hold). Pins near trunks. The 2000+3000 count is at the bar, so it may fail the activation rule after the fit test.

step_a_result.trigger_as_counted: obs.t >= 10 AND final mode === 'to next circle' AND drop gate open AND enemies beyond near_range (flat > 45 m) with seenAt(me.pos, h, [e], false) non-empty AND trees+buildings (treeHidden) do not already hide us from all of them AND a spot exists on the 12-bearing x 1/2/3 s walk grid, inside zoneKeep, straight-line walkable (clearLine), hidden by trees+buildings from all of them, that is either >= 0.5 s of walking closer to the entry point (1-3 s spots) or no farther from it (1-2 s spots), AND the trip still fits: (flat(me, spot) + flat(spot, entry)) / (zoneWalk x walk speed) + zoneBuffer < time left (APPLIED here; the research skipped it).
step_a_result.drop_gate: Drop gate (champion's, Doug 8:58 PM ET / drop-gate-rule.txt): off when dropMove or dropHold is on that tick, or when any drop passes the champion's drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, flat distance <= DROP_RUN_M 200 m, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time). Never 'any drop exists'.
step_a_result.passivity: IDENTICAL: every non-timing column (all but late_over_50ms, bot_ms_mean) of the instrumented rows equals /workspace/tester/runs/trees-b9492c6-<b>.csv on 96/96 games for each base (384/384); 0 instrumentation exceptions; per-game log decisions equal the CSV decisions column on every game.
step_a_result.method: Instrumented ONE copy of the champion P48 bot (b9492c6 bot files) at /tmp/stepa2/bot: passive per-decision checks for all four triggers at once, appended after every champion decision is final (just before act.move), inside try/catch, read-only on champion state, one JSON log per game; no action changed. Sim: /tmp/stepa2/sim = copy of /workspace/wt-tester-trees/tools/sim, byte-identical to 4b8663e (the Sim Tester's trees sim that wrote the reference rows). Run: `cd /tmp/stepa2 && STEPA_DIR=<dir> SEED_BASE=<b> bun sim/run.ts --bot /tmp/stepa2/bot/bot.ts --seeds 96 --jobs 1 --kit /workspace/mechfight-kit --out <csv> --trees` for b = 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000. Not /workspace/builder-sim/tools/sim/run.ts: that file is the committed bd6d1a2 version, which ignores SEED_BASE (always seeds 1000-1095) and --trees.
step_a_result.rule: coord/BUILD_CHECKLIST.md Step A (3d08872): fewer than 10/192 on either set retires the idea.
step_a_result.fit_note: Zone travel ('to next circle') runs only while the champion's own estimate says needed >= time left (needed = path distance / (zoneWalk x walk) + zoneBuffer + 2 s per tracked enemy near the route), so a detour fits only where the path is longer than the straight line via the spot or tracked enemies add slack.
